sentences.show: Three astronauts caught colds in space, and started arguing with Mission Control.
Apollo 7 launched on this day in 1968.
The first Apollo flight with a crew, after the fire that killed the crew of Apollo 1.
Commander Wally Schirra brought instant coffee, against doctors' orders.
By the end of day one, he had a cold. Soon all three did.
They still made the first live TV broadcast from an American spacecraft.
Tempers ran short. One astronaut said: "Somebody down there screwed up royally."
For re-entry, Houston wanted helmets on.
Schirra feared their blocked ears might burst. "I'm on board," he said. "I'm commanding."
They landed without helmets. The mission met 101 percent of its goals.
Two months later, Apollo 8 flew around the Moon.
But none of the three ever flew in space again.
Also on this day: the first American woman walked in space, and Reagan met Gorbachev in Iceland.
Every day has a launch like this one. Subscribe, and count down with us to our app.
